grammar.explanation: 首先确认时间，然后报名 sets an order, not a claim that either step is finished. 其次 may introduce the next reason in an explanation; it is not automatically later in clock time.

examples.zh: 首先确认时间，然后报名。
examples.py: shǒu xiān què rèn shí jiān , rán hòu bào míng .
examples.en: First confirm the time, then sign up.

examples.py: shǒu xiān tīng wèn tí , rán hòu huí dá .
examples.en: First hear the question, then answer.

examples.zh: 首先看来源，然后核对日期。
examples.py: shǒu xiān kàn lái yuán , rán hòu hé duì rì qī .
examples.en: First check the source, then the date.

commonMistakes.wrong: 首先确认，然后报名，所以已经报名了。
commonMistakes.right: 这是顺序安排，还没说明报名完成。
commonMistakes.why: A planned sequence is not a completion report.

grammar.explanation: 并且 adds a related action or quality to the preceding clause. 她核对时间，并且问了地点 states two actions; it does not imply causation. Avoid using 并且 where the intended relation is a contradiction.

examples.zh: 她核对时间，并且问了地点。
examples.py: tā hé duì shí jiān , bìng qiě wèn le dì diǎn .
examples.en: She checks the time and also asks the location.

examples.zh: 活动有讲解，并且有练习。
examples.py: huó dòng yǒu jiǎng jiě , bìng qiě yǒu liàn xí .
examples.en: The activity includes explanation and practice.

examples.py: xiān tīng wán , bìng qiě jì xià wèn tí .
examples.en: Hear everything first and also note questions.

commonMistakes.why: Use a contrastive connection for opposing information.

dialogue.title: A club plan
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find what is confirmed and what remains planned.

lines.zh: 社团去年成立，下周想开展语言活动。
lines.py: shè tuán qù nián chéng lì , xià zhōu xiǎng kāi zhǎn yǔ yán huó dòng .
lines.en: The club was founded last year and wants to launch a language activity next week.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 首先确认时间，然后报名，并且问场地有没有许可。
lines.py: shǒu xiān què rèn shí jiān , rán hòu bào míng , bìng qiě wèn chǎng dì yǒu méi yǒu xǔ kě .
lines.en: First confirm time, then register, and ask whether the venue has permission.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 职工都必须来吗？
lines.py: zhí gōng dōu bì xū lái ma ?
lines.en: Must all employees attend?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，自愿。名单也不等于出席记录。
lines.py: bù shì , zì yuàn . míng dān yě bù děng yú chū xí jì lù .
lines.en: No, attendance is voluntary; the list is not attendance.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 图展开了，小厂也建成了，就算已经经营了吗？
lines.py: tú zhǎn kāi le , xiǎo chǎng yě jiàn chéng le , jiù suàn yǐ jīng jīng yíng le ma ?
lines.en: The diagram is unfolded and the small factory finished; is it already trading?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不一定。建设、建成和经营是不同情况。先建立联系再问。
lines.py: bù yí dìng . jiàn shè , jiàn chéng hé jīng yíng shì bù tóng qíng kuàng . xiān jiàn lì lián xì zài wèn .
lines.en: Not necessarily. Construction, completion and trading differ; establish contact before asking.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Yes, everyone on the list must attend
Only the factory staff must attend

reading.title: Plan and conditions
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 设立报名点之前先确认权限，推进只写实际完成的部分。
lines.py: shè lì bào míng diǎn zhī qián xiān què rèn quán xiàn , tuī jìn zhǐ xiě shí jì wán chéng de bù fèn .
lines.en: Confirm authority before setting up registration; describe only actual progress.

lines.zh: 朋友从事教材制作，想创业，生意和工资条件都还要核对。
lines.py: péng you cóng shì jiào cái zhì zuò , xiǎng chuàng yè , shēng yi hé gōng zī tiáo jiàn dōu hái yào hé duì .
lines.en: The friend makes teaching materials and wants to start a business; business and wages still need checking.

lines.zh: 就业信息不是工作保证；人才的事业选择也要听本人。
lines.py: jiù yè xìn xī bù shì gōng zuò bǎo zhèng ; rén cái de shì yè xuǎn zé yě yào tīng běn rén .
lines.en: Employment information is not a job guarantee; hear talented people’s own career choices.

lines.zh: 首先看时间，其次看地点，并且记录不同意见。推动活动不是强迫参加。
lines.py: shǒu xiān kàn shí jiān , qí cì kàn dì diǎn , bìng qiě jì lù bù tóng yì jiàn . tuī dòng huó dòng bù shì qiǎng pò cān jiā .
lines.en: First consider time, next location, and record differing views; promoting an event is not forcing attendance.

lines.zh: 经济条件、增加的人数和气势不代替许可；展开讨论，能坚持也允许暂停。
lines.py: jīng jì tiáo jiàn , zēng jiā de rén shù hé qì shì bù dài tì xǔ kě ; zhǎn kāi tǎo lùn , néng jiān chí yě yǔn xǔ zàn tíng .
lines.en: Economic conditions, increased attendance and momentum do not replace permission; open discussion, with room to pause even when persistent.

questions.q: What is considered first and next?
choices: Attendance, then an automatic job offer

questions.q: Does employment information guarantee a job?
choices: Only when the diagram is unfolded
Actual confirmation, authority and voluntary choice
questions.answer: Actual confirmation, authority and voluntary choice

lines.zh: 【首先】看时间，其次看地点，并且记录不同意见。推动活动不是强迫参加。
lines.py: shǒu xiān kàn shí jiān , qí cì kàn dì diǎn , bìng qiě jì lù bù tóng yì jiàn . tuī dòng huó dòng bù shì qiǎng pò cān jiā .
lines.en: First consider time, next location, and record differing views; promoting an event is not forcing attendance.

lines.zh: 我把图展开了，计划是不是已经推进了？
lines.py: wǒ bǎ tú zhǎn kāi le , jì huà shì bú shì yǐ jīng tuī jìn le ?
lines.en: I unfolded the diagram; has the plan already advanced?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 纸展开了，人还没报名。
lines.py: zhǐ zhǎn kāi le , rén hái méi bào míng .
lines.en: The paper unfolded; nobody has registered yet.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那就先问时间，别让纸替我完成。
lines.py: nà jiù xiān wèn shí jiān , bié ràng zhǐ tì wǒ wán chéng .
lines.en: Then ask the time first; do not let paper complete it for me.
lines.speaker: a
